ref_text.narrator: Hi guys, this is Madhu. This is my simple trick. If you try this at the same time, trust me guys, this is very useful for you.

jobs.text: The Ramayana says Hanuman lifted an entire mountain, and carried it across India.
That mountain is Dronagiri. Today it stands more than seven thousand metres tall. Now, imagine it resting on one palm.
Brahmastra, Sudarshan Chakra, Kumbhakarna, Vasuki. What if they were real?
रामायण में लिखा है कि हनुमान जी पूरा द्रोणागिरी पर्वत उठाकर ले आए। लेकिन वह पर्वत असल में कितना बड़ा है?
